title: Revenge of Monosemanticity: Specialized Neurons Improve Data Efficiency in MLPs
abstract: arXiv:2608.24007v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding how neural networks learn and organize features is central to understanding their behavior. Much existing theory of feature learning has focused on the emergence of a global low-dimensional predictive geometry. We show that this picture is incomplete. In regression problems with clustered data, we demonstrate that multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) naturally develop monosemantic specialized neurons: individual neurons become strongly aligned with a specific predictive feature relevant to a particular region of the input space. Rather than learning a single global low-dimensional representation, MLPs learn a collection of local low-dimensional representations that can collectively span a high-dimensional space. This specialization provably gives MLPs a data-efficiency advantage over feature-learning methods based on a global low-dimensional representation.

translated_title: 单义性的复仇：特化神经元提升多层感知器的数据效率
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24007v1 公告类型：新 摘要：理解神经网络如何学习和组织特征对于理解其行为至关重要。现有许多特征学习理论侧重于全局低维预测几何结构的出现。我们表明这种观点是不完整的。在具有聚类数据的回归问题中，我们证明多层感知器（MLPs）自然发展出单义性特化神经元：单个神经元与输入空间特定区域相关的特定预测特征强对齐。MLPs并非学习单一的全局低维表示，而是学习一组局部低维表示，这些表示共同跨越一个高维空间。这种特化在理论上赋予MLPs相对于基于全局低维表示的特征学习方法在数据效率上的优势。
tldr: 本文证明多层感知器通过发展特化神经元学习局部低维表示，而非全局低维表示，从而在聚类数据的回归问题中显著提升数据效率。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that multilayer perceptrons learn local low-dimensional representations via specialized neurons rather than a global low-dimensional representation, providing a data-efficiency advantage in regression with clustered data.
